rules.hard_brake: acc = d/dt of 0.5 s-smoothed speed at 10 Hz; event = >= 3 consecutive samples (0.3 s) with acc <= -THR m/s^2 and speed >= 2 m/s at the run start; runs < 1 s apart merged; THR in {3,4,6}
rules.cut_in: vehicle track (not person/stroller/protruding_object/animal/unknown), at sample j: ego speed >= 2 m/s, track ahead 0 < lon <= 40 m in the ego frame, lateral distance to the ego's next-5 s path <= 1.25 m, track speed >= 1 m/s, motion direction within 45 deg of ego heading; and within the previous 2 s the same track had lateral distance >= 2.5 m while ahead (lon > 0); one event per track per 5 s
rules.out_of_view_return: same track id: a gap >= 1.0 s between consecutive raw observations, with the track within 60 m of the ego at both ends of the gap; one event per gap
rules.crossing: track speed >= 1 m/s, motion direction 60-120 deg from ego heading, ahead 0 < lon <= 50 m, lateral distance to the ego's next-5 s path <= 1.75 m; one event per track
rules.memory_relevant_moment: a training moment (anchor) within (t_event, t_event + 5 s]
